description: Correct tabulation of the SGD PRM5 curation record using experiment.category as the throughput field
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
S="https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/S000001379"
go=requests.get(S+"/go_details",timeout=120).json()
ph=requests.get(S+"/phenotype_details",timeout=120).json()
it=requests.get(S+"/interaction_details",timeout=120).json()

go_df=pd.DataFrame([dict(record="GO",go_id=g['go']['go_id'],term=g['go']['display_name'],
    aspect=g['go']['go_aspect'],annotation_type=g.get('annotation_type'),
    qualifier=g.get('qualifier'),source=(g.get('source') or {}).get('display_name'))
    for g in go]).drop_duplicates()

ph_df=pd.DataFrame([dict(record="PHENOTYPE",phenotype=(p.get('phenotype') or {}).get('display_name'),
    mutant_type=p.get('mutant_type'),
    experiment=(p.get('experiment') or {}).get('display_name'),
    experiment_category=(p.get('experiment') or {}).get('category'),
    strain=(p.get('strain') or {}).get('display_name'),
    pmid=(p.get('reference') or {}).get('pubmed_id')) for p in ph])

def partner(i):
    a=i.get('locus1',{}).get('display_name'); b=i.get('locus2',{}).get('display_name')
    return b if a=='PRM5' else a
it_df=pd.DataFrame([dict(record="INTERACTION",partner=partner(i),
    interaction_type=i.get('interaction_type'),annotation_type=i.get('annotation_type'),
    pmid=(i.get('reference') or {}).get('pubmed_id')) for i in it])

pd.concat([go_df,ph_df,it_df],ignore_index=True).to_csv("PRM5_SGD_curation_record.csv",index=False)

print("=== PHENOTYPE experiment.category (TRUE throughput field) ===")
cat=ph_df.experiment_category.value_counts(dropna=False); print(cat)
print("\n=== phenotype experiment names ===")
print(ph_df.experiment.value_counts())
print("\n=== the 18 phenotypes ===")
for _,r in ph_df.iterrows():
    print(f"   {r.phenotype:42s} | {r.mutant_type:14s} | {r.experiment_category:18s} | PMID {r.pmid}")
n_large=int((ph_df.experiment_category=='large-scale survey').sum()); n_small=len(ph_df)-n_large
print(f"\nlarge-scale survey = {n_large}/{len(ph_df)}   classical/other = {n_small}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))
g=go_df.groupby(['aspect','annotation_type']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
g.plot(kind='barh',stacked=True,ax=ax[0],color=['#2b6cb0','#b0b0b0'])
ax[0].set_title("GO record: MF and BP are the ROOT terms\n(SGD states function and process are unknown)",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("unique annotations"); ax[0].set_ylabel(""); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7,loc='lower right')

ax[1].bar(['large-scale\nsurvey','classical /\nsmall-scale'],[n_large,n_small],color=['#dd6b20','#2f855a'])
ax[1].set_title(f"{len(ph_df)} phenotype records, {n_large} from large-scale surveys\n(17 null, 1 overexpression; prm5$\\Delta$ is viable)",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("phenotype annotations"); ax[1].set_ylim(0,20)
for i,v in enumerate([n_large,n_small]): ax[1].text(i,v+0.4,str(v),ha='center',fontsize=10)

cnt=it_df.groupby(['interaction_type','annotation_type']).size()
ax[2].bar([f"{a}\n{b}" for a,b in cnt.index],cnt.values,color=['#805ad5','#3182ce'])
ax[2].set_title("40 interactions, none low-throughput;\n5 of 9 physical partners are mRNA-binding proteins",fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_ylabel("interaction records"); ax[2].set_ylim(0,36)
for i,v in enumerate(cnt.values): ax[2].text(i,v+0.6,str(v),ha='center',fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("PRM5 / YIL117C (P40476): the SGD curation record contains no direct functional evidence",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
